headline: 7 Meteora program IDs catalogued on Solana (vault, affiliate, treasury PDA, DLMM, DAMM v1/v2, DBC, Presale Vault, Alpha Vault, Farm, Stake2Earn, Mercurial Stable Swap); address_book schema is EVM-centric (0x40) so Solana base58 addresses cannot be stored in admin_addresses[].address field.
short_headline: 7+ Solana programs discovered; EVM schema mismatch

findings.text: Solana has no equivalent block-explorer name-tag search endpoint (no Etherscan-style searchHandler). Solscan and Explorer.solana.com were not directly fetchable via allowlist. Search results confirmed program IDs from third-party mappings (solanacompass.com, GitHub gist) consistent with official docs. DLMM program: Eo7WjKq67rjJQSZxS6z3YkapzY3eMj6Xy8X5EQVn5UaB (DAMM v1 / Meteora Pools Program also at same address per docs).

Official program/deployed-contracts listing found at https://docs.meteora.ag/get-started/pushing-the-boundaries-of-defi. Active programs: DLMM (LBUZKhRxPF3XUpBCjp4YzTKgLccjZhTSDM9YuVaPwxo), DAMM v2 (cpamdpZCGKUy5JxQXB4dcpGPiikHawvSWAd6mEn1sGG), DBC (dbcij3LWUppWqq96dh6gJWwBifmcGfLSB5D4DuSMaqN), Presale Vault (presSVxnf9UU8jMxhgSMqaRwNiT36qeBdNeTRKjTdbj), Alpha Vault (vaU6kP7iNEGkbmPkLmZfGwiGxd4Mob24QQCie5R9kd2), Dynamic Fee Sharing (dfsdo2UqvwfN8DuUVrMRNfQe11VaiNoKcMqLHVvDPzh), Zap (zapvX9M3uf5pvy4wRPAbQgdQsM1xmuiFnkfHKPvwMiz). Legacy programs: DAMM v1 (Eo7WjKq67rjJQSZxS6z3YkapzY3eMj6Xy8X5EQVn5UaB), Dynamic Vault (24Uqj9JCLxUeoC3hGfh5W3s9FM9uCHDS2SG3LYwBpyTi), Stake2Earn (FEESngU3neckdwib9X3KWqdL7Mjmqk9XNp3uh5JbP4KP), Farm (FarmuwXPWXvefWUeqFAa5w6rifLkq5X6E8bimYvrhCB1), Mercurial Stable Swap (MERLuDFBMmsHnsBPZw2sDQZHvXFMwp8EdjudcU2HKky). Docs also list vault-specific constants: VAULT_BASE_KEY (HWzXGcGHy4tcpYfaRDCyLNzXqBTv3E6BttpCH2vJxArv), treasury address (9kZeN47U2dubGbbzMrzzoRAUvpuxVLRcjW9XiFpYjUo4), affiliate program (GacY9YuN16HNRTy7ZWwULPccwvfFSBeNLuAQP7y38Du3).

Two audit PDFs linked: (1) https://drive.google.com/file/d/1CjdMl7LhJisnI1LTrAFt2Bvi5ahqq1yc/view — title 'Mercurial Finance - Final Report.pdf' (Bramah Systems); (2) https://drive.google.com/file/d/1cJ2ZH23yj9uO1otR2pLDQ1MP3OJm84IW/view — title 'Mercurial_Finance_Vault_Dynamic_AMM_Solana_Program_Security_Audit.pdf'. Both require Google Sign-In to view full content; in-scope addresses and audit firm cannot be extracted this run. A third auditor (Zellic) is mentioned by secondary sources. No scope addresses extractable from audit PDFs this run.

GitHub repos discovered: https://github.com/MeteoraAg/vault-sdk (public, 35 stars, TypeScript + Rust SDK, program ID 24Uqj9JCLxUeoC3hGfh5W3s9FM9uCHDS2SG3LYwBpyTi confirmed in README). Source vault program at mercurial-vault/programs/vault referenced in docs but repo URL https://github.com/MeteoraAg/mercurial-vault was allowlist-rejected (not previously surfaced in search results). No Foundry broadcast or hardhat-deploy artifacts found; Solana programs use Anchor deploy toolchain — no equivalent broadcast JSON expected.
Protocol is single-chain (Solana only). No multi-chain enumeration required.

Dynamic Vault program (24Uqj9JCLxUeoC3hGfh5W3s9FM9uCHDS2SG3LYwBpyTi) acts as a factory — individual vaults are PDAs derived from token mint + VAULT_BASE_KEY. The DeFiPunkd read-API does not support Solana (supported chainIds: 1, 10, 56, 130, 137, 324, 8453, 42161, 43114, 59144, 81457, 534352, 11155111); factory child enumeration via that API is not possible. Vault list not enumerable from this run without a Solana RPC call.

Role taxonomy applied to all discovered programs: Dynamic Vault program (vault/factory), Affiliate Vault program (other), VAULT_BASE_KEY (other — PDA seed constant), treasury PDA (treasury), DLMM (pool/factory), DAMM v1+v2 (pool/factory), DBC (factory), Presale Vault (vault), Alpha Vault (vault), Dynamic Fee Sharing (other), Zap (router), Farm (other), Stake2Earn (other), Mercurial Stable Swap (pool). All actor_class set to unknown — on-chain bytecode/upgrade-authority not readable via EVM tooling.

All Solana program IDs are base58-encoded 32-byte public keys; the admin_addresses[].address schema requires 0x-prefixed 40-hex EVM addresses. Solana addresses cannot be stored in that field without violating schema validation. Addresses are recorded in admin_addresses[].role field suffixed with the base58 program ID, and address field is omitted. This is a schema limitation for Solana protocols — noted as D8 in unknowns.

rationale.verdict: Discovery walked official docs (docs.meteora.ag), GitHub (MeteoraAg/vault-sdk), and search results. 13 Solana program IDs catalogued (1 primary vault program + 12 related programs/constants). Audit PDFs inaccessible due to Google Drive auth wall. DeFiPunkd on-chain API does not support Solana, so no read-API calls could be made. All addresses are Solana base58 and cannot populate EVM-schema admin_addresses[].address field.

protocol_metadata.about: Meteora Dynamic Vaults is a yield aggregation layer on Solana that allows liquidity providers and integrator protocols (AMMs, wallets, treasuries) to deploy idle assets into vetted Solana lending platforms such as Kamino, Solend, and MarginFi. The vault program automatically rebalances allocations across strategies approximately once per minute, earning lending yield on top of any swap-fee income. Users deposit a supported token and receive LP tokens representing their share, redeemable by burning against the vault's unlocked balance. Originally launched as Mercurial Finance, the protocol rebranded to Meteora; the core vault program (24Uqj9JCLxUeoC3hGfh5W3s9FM9uCHDS2SG3LYwBpyTi) is listed as a legacy product that is maintained but will receive no new feature development.
